Session manages g3d-termd sessions in the configured namespace directly, by
session name.

An agent's session is named after it with a prefix ("agent-helper" for agent
"helper"); session list shows which agent each session belongs to. To remove
an agent, use "agent cleanup", which also deletes its record.

Usage:
  agent session [flags]
  agent session [command]

Examples:
  agent session new scratch
  agent session list

Available Commands:
  new         Create a session running a shell
  kill        Kill a session
  list        List all sessions in the namespace, with the agent each belongs to

Flags:
  -h, --help   help for session

Global Flags:
      --backend string          Backend for spawn or adopt: claude, aider, agy, or shell (spawn requires it or --backend-config; adopt auto-detects)
      --backend-config string   JSON file defining a custom backend (or app settings); pass it again to status/wait/watch for agents spawned with it
  -q, --quiet                   Don't print hints (results and errors still print)
      --termd-ns string         g3d-termd namespace (default: agents; never default or wall)

Use "agent session [command] --help" for more information about a command.
